name: Ring of Spell Rotation
body:
Aura moderate evocation; CL 11th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring appears to be a ring of counterspells. The wearer may cast a single spell of 1st to 6th level into the ring as normal. Once the wearer casts any spell of between 1st and 6th level not directed at the ring, the ring absorbs the spell being cast and releases the spell which it previously stored.

This ring can be removed by casting remove curse upon it. Doing so, however, releases the stored spell, targeting the wearer. The ring’s enchantment remains intact.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of counterspells

Identification DC 36
False Identification DC 26
